occultengineering.ponder.mechanical_cham: Using the Mechanical Chamber to Automate Rituals
The Mechanical Chamber can be used in place of a Golden Sacrificial Bowl for Rituals which craft items
They also only extract the resulting items
It must be powered from the top or bottom with Rotational Power
The faster the Rotation, the faster the Ritual will complete
Surround the chamber with chalks and other ritual blocks
The chamber will pull automatically from Sacrificial Bowls within 8 blocks
The bowls can either be filled by hand or through automation
Mechanical Arms are the easiest way to use the chamber
They only insert bound books once the rest of the ritual is complete
The Mechanical Chamber will then initiate the Ritual
occultengineering.ponder.mechanical_pulv: Processing Items in the Mechanical Pulverizer
Pulverizers can be used to crush items into dust
Power them from the back with a Shaft
Right-click the Pulverizer with a valid item
After some time, the result can be retrieved by Right-clicking again
Inputs and Outputs can also be automated
occultengineering.ponder.otherworld_dete: Otherworld Detectors detect whether the nearest player can see into the Otherworld
This can be accomplished by either consuming Demon's Dream Fruit to get the Third Eye, or by wearing Otherworld Goggles
A comparator can also be used to get the distance to the player
occultengineering.ponder.phlogiport.head: Transporting Items with the Phlogiport
occultengineering.ponder.phlogiport.text: Phlogiports can be used to wirelessly transfer items short distances
The package will be wirelessly sent to its inventory
If there are multiple ports with the same name...
They will receive matching packages randomly
Assign it an address in the inventory UI for it to function
Items can be inserted via the Inventory UI
If the address of an inserted package does not match it..
..and there is another Phlogiport within range with that name
